Anjali Chauhan discovered that the trading dashboard showed unrealistic gains that could not be withdrawn, at which point all communication from the platform's representatives ceased.

Kavita Das was told to remain reachable at all times on 7908838483 for further instructions. Kavita Das was told that stepping away from the call, even briefly, would be treated as an admission of guilt and would trigger immediate arrest. The number that called me was 7908838483. Kavita Das was told to deposit Rs. 6,75,678.30 into account A-02386 as an 'RBI compliance fine', with an assurance that the amount would be returned after the investigation concluded.
